# Contributing

This is a pet project, so there are no promises that a PR will be merged. For anything bigger than a small fix, open an issue first to talk it through.

## Before opening a PR

```bash
./scripts/ktfmt.sh     # format changed files
./scripts/detekt.sh    # static analysis
./scripts/compile.sh   # compile changed modules
./scripts/test.sh      # test changed modules
```

Bugs in Actual itself should go to the [upstream repo](https://github.com/actualbudget/actual/issues).
